evals.prompt: Where do I go to use the Microsoft 365 admin center?
evals.expected_output: Returns Microsoft 365 Admin Center with https://admin.cloud.microsoft, includes source-backed portal entry details from admin.json, mentions the aka.ms/admincenter secondary URL or B2B tenant URL caveat, and does not invent URLs.
assertions: The output includes Microsoft 365 Admin Center
The output includes https://admin.cloud.microsoft
The output references msportals admin.json or the Microsoft 365 Admin Center source references
The output does not persist a tenant ID

evals.prompt: Help me add a Microsoft 365 user and assign a license safely.
evals.expected_output: Uses Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation before giving guidance, starts with read-only prerequisites, mentions License Administrator or User Administrator, explains Users > Active users and license assignment paths, and identifies approval boundaries for user and license changes.
assertions: The output mentions Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation
The output includes Users > Active users or Billing > Licenses navigation
The output mentions License Administrator or User Administrator
The output separates read-only prerequisites from user or license changes

evals.prompt: Show me how to check Microsoft 365 service health and Message center major updates before a rollout.
evals.expected_output: Uses official Microsoft documentation, starts with read-only Health dashboard and Message center navigation, mentions major update tags or act-by dates, and describes how to use Message ID or support context without changing tenant settings.
assertions: The output references service health or Health dashboard documentation
The output references Message center documentation
The output includes read-only navigation to Health or Message center
The output mentions major updates, Act by dates, Message ID, or service usage/relevance context

evals.prompt: I need to change external sharing for SharePoint and review Teams app policies from the Microsoft 365 admin center.
evals.expected_output: Identifies Microsoft 365 Admin Center as the hub, routes SharePoint-specific changes to the SharePoint Admin Center skill and Teams app policy work to the Teams Admin Center skill, uses admin-change-safety for changes, and avoids duplicating specialist portal procedures.
assertions: The output routes SharePoint-specific work to SharePoint Admin Center or a future SharePoint portal skill
The output routes Teams app policy work to Teams Admin Center or a future Teams portal skill
The output identifies the work as change-sensitive and requiring admin-change-safety or approval
The output does not provide unsourced specialist portal procedures

evals.prompt: Help me add a custom domain to Microsoft 365 and switch email over.
evals.expected_output: Uses official Microsoft domain setup documentation, identifies Domain Name Administrator prerequisites, explains Domain Connect versus manual DNS at a high level, warns that MX/DNS mistakes can cause mail or service outages, and requires admin-change-safety before changes.
assertions: The output references official Microsoft domain setup documentation
The output mentions Domain Name Administrator
The output mentions Domain Connect or manual DNS records
The output warns about MX/DNS outage risk and approval boundaries
